notes: TEMPLATE for a real public program. Before use: (1) register on the platform and READ the current brief end-to-end; (2) copy the EXACT in-scope assets into scope_allow and every out-of-scope/third-party asset into scope_deny; (3) set authorized=true ONLY after you have accepted the program's terms (that acceptance is your authorization and your limit); (4) keep intrusive_allowed=FALSE - do not enable exploitation/spraying/C2 against production; (5) honor the program's rate limit and any required identifying header (e.g. Intigriti: <=10 req/s + X-Intigriti-Username header; GitHub: no excessive traffic). Most programs forbid or heavily restrict automated scanning on production - when in doubt, test manually and use a sanctioned range for tooling. Run with APOLLO_ENFORCE_SCOPE=1 and start in APOLLO_DRY_RUN=1.
